content: Si Isaac diyà Med-ubpà te Gerar

Ne mid-aǥi en is bitil zutun te lugar he mid-ubpaan ni Isaac, kenà haazà kes bitil te kaazen pa ni Abraham. Midhendiyà si Isaac te ki Abimelec, sikan is hadì te menge Filistihanen he ziyà te inged he Gerar.
Ne mibpaahà is Nengazen kandin, he egkaǥi te, “Kenè ka hendiyà te Ehipto; diyan ke zà ubpà te lugar he ibpeehè ku kenikew.
Kayi ke zà ubpà dèpa su edumahan ku sikew wey edtuvazan ku sikew. Ibeǥey ku heini kenikew wey ziyà te menge kevuwazan nu heini is langun he tanà. Edtumanen ku is pesarig ku te amey nu he si Abraham.

Edhimuwen ku he medmezakel is menge kevuwazan nu iring kezakel te menge vituen diyà te langit, ne ibeǥey ku heini kandan is langun he tanà. Ne pinaaǥi kandan, edtuvazan ku is langun he etew kayi te kelibutan.
Ebeelan ku heini su mibpezumazuma si Abraham kedì. Midtuman din is langun he menge suǥù wey penurù ku.”
Umbe ziyà med-ubpà si Isaac te Gerar.

Mekempet si Rebeka, umbe emun ebpenginsà haazà is menge tig-Gerar ziyà te ki Isaac mehitenged te esawa zin, ne edtevaken din te etevey zin si Rebeka. Egkahandek sikandin he egkaǥi he esawa zin, su kela ke himetayi zan sikandin para maaǥew zan si Rebeka.

Malù en neuǥet is ked-ubpà eni Isaac diyà te Gerar. Sevaha he andew zutun, neserengà he midsinulew ziyà te bintanà si Abimelec he hadì te menge Filistihanen, ne neehè din he ebpekepkepà si Isaac wey si Rebeka.
Ne zutun impetawag din si Isaac, ke sikandin te, “Esawa nu ves sikandin? Maan is migkaǥi nu he etevey nu sikandin?” Ne midtavak si Isaac te, “Nahandek a, kela ke himetayi a tenged kandin.”
Ne migkaǥi si Abimelec te, “Kenà meupiya is mibeelan nu kenami. Penenglitan ke zuen kayi te menge sakup ku midhulid kandin, iyan ka pezem egkevasul te egkehimu he salè dey.”
Ne zutun impesavut ni Abimelec is langun he menge sakup din. Ke sikandin te, “Is minsan hentei he ebaal te kenà meupiya kayi te maama wey te esawa zin ne edhimetayan.”
Ne zutun he lugar mid-ezek si Isaac ne nekeraǥun sikandin te ke 100 metakep te haazè dà he tuig, tenged midtuvazan sikandin te Nengazen.
Mid-iseg sikandin med-uswag taman te utew en sikandin midsepian.
Neima kandin is menge Filistihanen su utew mezakel is menge kerehidu zin, kambing, baka, wey menge suluǥuen din.
Ne tenged te kegkeima te menge Filitihanen ki Isaac, mibumbunan dan te tanà is menge kalut he mibpekelutan te menge suluǥuen dengan te amey zin he si Abraham.
Ne zutun migkaǥi si Abimelec diyà te ki Isaac te, “Deyzey ke ed-awè kew kayi, su lavew en is keniyu he ǥehem te kenami.”
Umbe mid-awè en dutun si Isaac, ne ziyà medhalin te zal-ug te Gerar ne midtutulda sikandin ne ziyà med-ubpà.

Ne mid-umanan din pekeluti haazà is menge kalut te amey zin dengan he si Abraham he mibumbunan te menge Filistihanen hein minatey en si Abraham. Ne is menge inngazan ni Abraham duen te menge kalut, ne iyan daan inngazan ni Isaac.
Diyà te zal-ug, mibangbang is menge suluǥuen ni Isaac te beǥu he kalut ne nekeehè dan te serebseb.

Piru mibpekidtebek is menge bekidu he tig-Gerar te menge bekidu ni Isaac su kandan kun haazà he kalut. Umbe migngezanan haazà ni Isaac he kalut te Esek, he ke và dà egkeǥiya, “Tebek,” tenged te mibpekidtebek is menge tig-Gerar kandin.

Ne mid-uman mebangbang is menge suluǥuen din te selakew en he kalut, piru midtebekaayan dan ded haazà te menge tig-Gerar. Umbe migngezanan ni Isaac haazà he kelut te Sitna, he ke và dà egkeǥiya, “Tebekaayaan.”

Mid-awà dutun ensi Isaac ne mid-uman mebangbang sikandan te selakew-en maan he kalut. Wazè dan human heini lewenaayi, umbe migngezanan ni Isaac haazà is kalut te Rehobot, he ke và dà egkeǥiya, “Melu-ag.” Su ke sikandin te, “Mibeǥayan kiw en human te Nengazen te melu-ag he ubpaan para med-iseg kiw pa mebmezakel kayi.”
Ne puun dutun, midhalin si Isaac diyà te Beersheba.

Dutun te haazà he kezukilemi te kebpekeuma zin diyà, mibpaahà kandin is Nengazen he egkaǥi te, “Iyan a kes Megbevayà te amey nu he si Abraham. Kenè ka mahandek su iyan a zuma nu. Edtuvazan ku sikew ne edhimuwen ku he utew medmezakel is menge kevuwazan nu tenged te suluǥuen ku he si Abraham.”
Umbe mibaal si Isaac dutun te pemuhatà ne mid-azap te Nengazen. Impehitindeg din dutun he lugar is tulda zin ne impevangbang din is menge suluǥuen din te kalut.
Midhendiyà si Hadì Abimelec he ebpuun te Gerar ne miduma zin is sumesambag din he si Ahuzat wey sikan is egalen te menge sundaru zin he si Picol.
Mid-insaan ni Isaac sikandan te, “Maan is midhengkayi kew te kedì? Egkepeukan e man keniyu, umbe impaawà a keniyu ziyan te lugar niw?”
Ne midtavak dan te, “Nesavut dey he is Nengazen eduma kenikew, umbe neisip dey he kinanahanglan he edhimu kiw te kebpekid-uyun duma zutun is penangdù. Penaad ka kenami
he kenè key keniyu pesipelahi, su wazè dey man daan sikew pesipelahi hein diyè ka te kenami. Mibpurungan dey sikew, impeǥenat dey sikew he melinawen. Deyzey pezem he tuvazi ke pa te Nengazen.”
Umbe midtukud si Isaac te keemuran para kandan, ne migkaan dan wey nemen-inum dan.
Utew pa meselem dutun te sunud he andew, ne mibpesèsaazè dan. Ne hein nepasad, ne impeǥenat ni Isaac sikandan he melipayen.
Haazà he andew, nekeuma is menge suluǥuen ni Isaac, ne midtudtulan dan sikandin he zuen wahig duen te kalut he mibengbangan dan.
Migngezanan ni Isaac haazà te Siba. Umbe taman en guntaan iyan ngazan dutun is Beersheba.
Ne hein 40 en is penuiǥen ni Esau, mid-esawa zin si Judith he anak ni Beeri he Hitihanen, wey si Besemat he anak ni Elon he Hitihanen daan.
Utew ingkeseeng ni Isaac wey ni Rebeka haazà is menge ambey zan.
